Protein–protein interaction (PPI) network of the bioactive compound KRN against obesity

Protein–protein interaction (PPI) network of the bioactive compound KRN against obesity. Node sizes correspond to their degrees, with larger nodes representing higher degrees of connectivity, while darker colours highlight the importance of nodes, with darker shades indicating more significant hub genes. Key nodes, including SRC, GFR, HIF1A, PIK3CA, MTOR, STAT1, GSK3B, and CASP3, are identified as potential therapeutic targets in obesity-related pathways

Publication

In Silico exploration of Karanjin for anti-obesity potential through ADMET profiling, network pharmacology, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations (2025) Natasha Sura Anak Lubau, et al. Sci Rep. 2025;15(NA). Figure: F4.
